hooks.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE 'src/content/blog/.*\.md'; then cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && bash scripts/validate-frontmatter.sh "$FILE"; fi
if git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '\.(astro|ts|tsx|md|mdx|css)$'; then echo 'Modified source files detected. Run npm run build to verify the site builds correctly before committing.'; fi
